⭐ Extremely disappointing experience. Poor communication, unexpected costs and a complete lack of transparency.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at Holly House Vets and have seriously lost confidence in this practice.

On 25 September 2026, I took my dog in because he had an anal gland problem involving a draining fistula. He was prescribed anti-inflammatory medication and antibiotics, but the antibiotic course was only for five days.

By 30 September, my dog had not improved and had run out of antibiotics, so I had to pay for another consultation. This time, he was prescribed antibiotics for two weeks, and the dosage was increased from 250 mg to 500 mg. I would like a clear explanation of the reasoning behind the initial treatment plan and the subsequent change in dosage and duration.

The costs were:

* £127.35 for the first consultation and anti-inflammatory medication.
* £42.62 for the initial antibiotics.
* £182.40 for the second consultation and further antibiotics.

Total: £352.37 in just five days between appointments.

However, my biggest complaint concerns the handling of my Pet Protect insurance.

I chose Pet Protect partly because of its relationship with Holly House. Previously, the practice dealt directly with my insurer, Pet Protect paid the practice, and any remaining matters were then settled between the insurer and me. I did not have to pay substantial veterinary bills upfront.

I specifically valued this arrangement because I took out insurance to protect myself against unexpected veterinary expenses, not to find myself paying hundreds of pounds upfront and then having to chase reimbursements.

I have now discovered that, apparently, direct claims are no longer handled in the same way unless the invoice exceeds £500. Nobody informed me of this change before my dog’s appointments.

Had I known about this, I would have seriously reconsidered continuing to use Holly House and would likely have changed veterinary practices much earlier. This was an important factor in my decision to stay with the practice and use Pet Protect.

The situation became even more frustrating when I tried to resolve the claims issue. On 25 September, I was told that the practice would submit the insurance claim for me. When I returned on 30 September, I specifically asked whether the first claim had been submitted and was told it had not. I then asked for both visits to be claimed and was told this would be done.

Yet, when I contacted the practice again on 12 October, neither claim had been submitted. I was then told that they were waiting for me to complete the claim form myself.

Why was I not told this from the beginning? Why was I given the impression that the practice would handle the claims if I was actually expected to do it myself?

I understand that veterinary treatment costs money, and I am happy to pay for my dog’s care. What I find unacceptable is the lack of transparency about changes to insurance arrangements, the contradictory information and the time I have had to spend chasing something I was told would be dealt with.

When your dog is unwell, you are already worried. The last thing you need is additional stress and unexpected financial pressure because important information has not been communicated properly.

This experience has seriously damaged my trust in Holly House. I expected better communication, transparency and customer service.

My advice to other pet owners is to confirm the insurance and direct payment arrangements in writing before agreeing to treatment. Do not assume that arrangements you have relied on previously are still in place.

Based on my experience, I would seriously reconsider returning to this practice.
Yet again excellent service and care, friendly, and helpful, we are more than satisfied with our visit. The advice given was reassuring. .
Susie was in for her yearly check up and vaccination, everything checked & done properly to our satisfaction, very happy with all proceedings.

By far the nicest vets we've used, all the reception staff and vets are always so nice and take great care of our border terrier. The pricing seems fair as well unlike other vets we've used in the past.
Always very caring. Tilly loves coming to the vets.

Excellent vet
Explained pros and cons of all treatments keeping my dogs wellbeing in mind
Wonderful prompt treatment with tablet prescriptions
Always a great experience with our sassy fluff Genevieve

My cat has been a patient at Holly House for about 8 years. The vets are great: kind and very knowledgeable, but getting an appointment for a sick or injured animal can be really difficult. The practice seems to prioritise appointments for dental checks, wellness checks etc. While this brings in a steady stream of income, isn’t it more important that sick animals are seen promptly? I do think the business model needs to change. My cat has IBD and needs corticosteroid treatment from time to time. Recently I was charged £18 for 4 Prednisone tablets! Prednisone is very cheap so the £18 charge is not justified.
Friendly and helpful staff. Easy to get an appointment, either by booking online or via phone. Clinical staff give sound advice and seem to genuinely care about the animals in their care

Very disappointing experience.
I called to ask a simple question about whether the practice stocks a specific puppy vaccine. Before I could finish explaining, the person I spoke to hung up on me without any explanation.

Ease of appointments
Professional confidence inspiring.
Hello Ian, thank you for the 5 star review!

A wonderful veterinary practice - every single member of staff is so kind and compassionate, and so helpful. Coming to the vet is often a stressful experience for vet and owner, but they always make me feel so at ease and are so gentle with my cat. I wouldn't go anywhere else in Leeds.

This is a truly fantastic vet. All the staff seem happy, confident, and competent, and they're very accommodating towards things that make accessing vet care difficult. I've been with them for around 5 years with my senior golden retriever and previously two bunnies. Medical care like this is worth its weight in gold and I think the prices are very reasonable for the level of care and attention you receive.

I was able to get an appointment on the same day. The vet that I saw was so kind and engaged in a really useful discussion about potential options, pros and cons and helped us to achieve an outcome that was best for our dog! Many thanks for your care and compassion.

Holly House vets are so lovely. One of my cats had a couple of surgeries a few years ago and could not have been more looked after. I got my appointments mixed up for them this week but the receptionist knew exactly how difficult getting any cat in a cat box for an appointed time and squeezed us in! We were very grateful.
The vet that we saw was absolutely brilliant. She took time to make our frenchie so relaxed and took time to get to know her .
Care thoughtful and professional as always
Horrible service cut me off the phone again. Completely careless establishment !!!
I had a great experience with Martina, one of the vets at Holly House. She was extremely kind and patient with my elderly and rather feisty small dog! I would definitely recommend Holly House

Holly House vets have been taking care of my dog for a few years.  I am very happy with being able to get appointments readily and both vets and nurses seem passionate and focused on looking after your pet
Vet's nurse Ellie was brilliant with my sweet girl 🐶 …
First visit, very thorough and explained everything that was going on.
Absolutely amazing, the receptionist was so kind! I just rescued a kitten, and I needed to get him checked, they got me an appointment the same day! Was really really impressed!
Great service. They do hold back some appointments so if nothing showing on online system do call if you need something sooner
The most amazing vets I've been to. So lovely to see the empathy on the vets and reception faces and such kind words.

Recently completed a puppy training course with Ellie at Holly House. Absolutely fantastic, helped explain and demonstrate useful commands, but was also super happy to answer questions/give advice on issues specific to each dog.  Hope to join the next level course in the future!

⸻

Losing my dog was devastating. What made it even more painful was the way communication was handled throughout my experience.

When I first called because my dog had collapsed, I was told they were dealing with another emergency and to call back in ten minutes. At that moment, it was truly a life-or-death situation. Pet owners need immediate guidance, reassurance, or clear triage direction in emergencies. Being asked to simply call back left me feeling unsupported during the most critical moment. Tragically, my dog was put to sleep due to a splenic bleed — a situation the vets could not have changed.

Afterwards, when I raised concerns, I was advised there was a 14-day timeframe in relation to my complaint. This was later described as a misunderstanding. I understand that miscommunications can happen; however, clarity and consistency are especially important when someone is grieving and seeking answers. The shifting explanation added confusion and unnecessary stress at an already traumatic time.

Rather than clear accountability, responses often felt focused on process rather than acknowledging the emotional impact of the situation. Clients should not have to repeatedly push for clarity when raising legitimate concerns.

While reports were eventually provided, the overall handling of communication added avoidable distress during an already heartbreaking experience.

I hope Holly House reflects seriously on how communication, triage procedures, ownership, and empathy are delivered in situations where pets’ lives are at stake

This was my first visit to Holly House and I registered Rex. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience really comfortable. Even though Rex was quite noisy, everyone was very patient and understanding. Overall, a really positive experience.”

We the the unfortunate need for an emergency vets on Sunday- whilst a situation I would not wish on anyone if you ever do need one I could not speak more highly of Holly House.

From the initial phone call to everyone we dealt with, Holly House were fantastic. I was a mess and despite what I imagine is probably a very high pressured environment for the staff everyone was so supportive and kind. Our dog had to be kept in for monitoring and we were kept updated and at every stage every option was communicated clearly.
Nurse  went above and beyond
My little pup needed her jabs and the staff were all great
both reception and veterinary staff very friendly. Appointment was swift but still caring for our cat and good shop in reception

Disappointing decline in service over the years, a real shame. Should have left the sooner. Poor communication, misdiagnosis and expensive.

Always had a positive experience in terms of friendliness from staff, however too many issues to ignore.

Poor communication between staff leading to unnecessary extra visits e.g. not advising sedation necessary to take blood from a cat, despite him needing restraint from three people to clip claws on the previous visit. This meant an entirely wasted visit, and about £80 for the hassle. They did offer for him to come back under sedation for blood tests, but as we since discovered they can't perform the surgery without us taking him to the Ilkley branch, we have declined.

Being told three times a colleague would contact us to discuss the dental work for our cat and not following through, leaving us to chase them us. One person said it would be in Leeds, one saying it had to be Ilkley.

Misdiagnosis of an infected toe - were told our dog had almost certainly torn his cruciate ligament before the vet even laid hands on him, judging by his limp. Advised to book for xray/surgery a week later if no improvement. I requested he was seen again in the meantime as he was in so much discomfort. A second vet immediately diagnosed the infected toe. Antibiotics sorted the problem; diagnosing correctly to start with would have saved my dog several days of pain.

Told our cat probably had a broken tail after she presented with a limp tail. Advised to bring her back for xrays. On the next visit a different vet discovered it was an infected cat bite - again received antibiotics later than we should have.

Left for another practice today to get our cat's teeth extracted locally. The price different we've been quoted is substantial, despite the new surgery having better, local facilities and offering a more comprehensive package. Holly House charging £250 more than the new practice, and not even including bloodwork in the price.

I found a badly injured pigeon which a cat had got to. As i didn't know how to help it,  I googled and found a good review for them. When I called, they asked me to bring the pigeon to their hospital. When I got there, they took it in immediately and said they would treat it and look after it at their cost.

Very friendly, relaxed atmosphere - I felt my puppy was in good hands for her second lot of jabs & first trip to the vets. The vet we saw was brilliant, handled our puppy amazingly she didn’t even know she’d had an injection. Would recommend!
Very good service a pleasure to use
Such amazing, diligent and caring staff
Nothing but great experiences,  the most warm friendly staff. I would highly recommend  .

Brought my African Grey Mr B for his nails trimming and Harriet and Amy were amazing 👏 they were so good at handling him as he doesn't like being handled and he was very calm with them. Harriet explained everything she was doing and took the time to ask if there was anything else I needed to know. Wonderful service would certainly recommend them and only £30 for his appointment which i thought was so good as I expected so much more. Thank you Harriet and Amy for a perfect visit

Our vet Olympia was fantastic.  Listened to the concerns I had for our dog and was very patient and thorough in her examination.  I was reassured by her suggested approach and advice.  Very happy all round with her kindness and professionalism when treating Bailey.

After 2 occasions of poor service decided it was time to move.
They are losing the personal touch. The final straw was my cat having to wait up to six weeks for an operation to remove a tooth when potentially she could be in pain. Not putting the animals first at all.

Wonderful vets with lots of knowledge of rats and exotics. I now have my dog go here and they have been amazing from her being a puppy very clear on everything.

The vets and workers here really care about the animals they treat.

Update
Our dog had several baby teeth causing problems and the vets were absolutely amazing. Really professional and caring for our pup. I'd never use another vets.
Very friendly, caring staff. They listen to the clients and act on the information. They show empathy with the animals and respect them.
Poor service provision as clinician did not communicate with staff and this resulted in my cat not getting much needed antibiotics in time.

This vet used to be good but over the years it has gone downhill while the prices have shot up. Communication has got worse, eg I was told I could book an animal health certificate appointment but when I came to book it they told me, rather late in the day, that they don't do them anymore. I was told the decision was made by head office not them.

Other problems include an animal health certificate with the wrong vaccine dates  which almost stopped us getting into France, it cost £250! Also when my dog had digestion problems they did several expensive tests and sold me expensive supplements but it turned out a change in diet was all that was needed. We did this through trial and error.

So it's a shame but I think the corporate owners are maximising profit above pet welfare and customer satisfaction. Most of the staff are ok however.
Wonderful service, polite and friendly. Made to feel welcome immediately. Accommodating.

Very kind. Everyone was very polite. The staff answered my every question. And when it came to putting my pet to sleep they were very considerate and sympathetic I new she was given the best care up to the end and after.
So pleased to have found this vets - they've looked after our animals so well. Would definitely recommend to anyone!
Lovely staff . Very helpful
